description: IT support ticket store backing Power Apps, Power Automate, and the Microsoft Graph API integration.

columns.name: Title
columns.description: Ticket ID in the format TKT-XXXXXXXX, auto-generated by the orchestrator.

columns.name: Description
columns.description: Full issue description including error messages and reproduction steps.

columns.name: Submitter
columns.description: Email address of the user who submitted the ticket.

columns.name: Assignee
columns.description: Email address of the team assigned to the ticket.

columns.name: Resolution
columns.description: Resolution notes from the assigned team or auto-generated by the orchestrator.
